Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: Scopes memory capture to specific projects or sessions, enabling targeted and organized long-term recall.
description.zh: 将记忆捕获限定在特定项目或会话内，实现精准且有组织的长期回顾。

description.en: Automatically captures and stores runtime context and project documents for persistent, searchable memory across sessions.
description.zh: 自动捕获运行时上下文和项目文档，实现跨会话的持久化、可搜索记忆。

description.en: Task ledger board for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): read-only board over task-ledger skill workspaces. The task-ledger skill is bundled — install the plugin, get the skill globally.
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。
One-command skinning for DSH Web: 8 original themes, wallpaper (opacity/blur/gradient/URL), per-user accent, shareable theme packs, favorites and surprise-me. Purely native token system.
description.zh: DSH Web 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊/渐变/URL）、每用户强调色、主题包导入导出与分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: Create, edit, inspect, and deliver spreadsheets, documents, presentations, databases, and canvases in DeepSeek Harness, with live preview and worktree review.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑、检查和交付表格、文档、演示文稿、多维表格和画布，支持实时预览与 worktree 审阅。

description.en: DFY DSH 对话外观设置：调节回复行距与过程行距，并扩展本地文件的打开方式。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。

Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.
description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.en: Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web and Desktop, plus Codex, Cursor, Doubao and WorkBuddy: a sidebar Background panel, saved named themes, a sound switch, restore-last-background, a background-only "slack" mode, and /bg, /bg-theme, /bg-clear commands.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与 Desktop 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景（也支持 Codex、Cursor、豆包、WorkBuddy）：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存命名主题、声音开关、恢复上次背景、只留背景的摸鱼模式，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Manage the DeepSeek Harness skill catalog from Settings: list what DSH actually resolves, enable or disable a skill by policy without touching its source file, read and edit SKILL.md, and create, import, or permanently delete skills.
Provides a Codex-style interface for interacting with DeepSeek Harness, enhancing the user experience.
description.zh: 用Codex的方式打开deepseek-harness

description.en: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

description.en: Folia 壁纸引擎：把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸搬进 DSH 界面（场景实时渲染 / 视频 / 网页），内置液态玻璃与 Folia 吉祥物，并可从自建站点拉取壁纸。单包形态（组件已合并）。

Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.

Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 零配置地将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: Right-click any attachment or path in the transcript and hand it to your own action: send it to a WeChat contact, open it in Chrome, or anything else you configure — one right-click, anything you want. Ships with quote-into-composer, reveal in the OS file manager, copy path and Send to…, and lets you add your own entries (command, open with, shortcut, link, PowerShell). Menus are drawn in the app's own style, never the system one.
description.zh: 对话里的附件和路径，右键就是你自己的入口：发给微信好友、用谷歌浏览器打开，或者你想到的任何处理——一个右键，做你想做的任何事。开箱带引用回输入框、在文件管理器里定位、复制路径、发送到…，再往下自己加一条入口（命令、打开方式、快捷指令、链接、PowerShell）。菜单跟着 App 的深浅色和圆角走，不是系统弹窗。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change preview for DSH
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Government data inspector covering completeness, accuracy and timeliness metrics.
description.zh: 政务数据巡检工具，覆盖数据完整率、准确率、时效率等核心指标。

description.en: Integrates ChatGPT/Codex subscription as a provider for DeepSeek Harness, supporting OAuth login, subscription search, and quota display.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，无需 OpenAI API Key 或 Codex CLI，支持 OAuth 登录、订阅搜索与额度显示 | ChatGPT/Codex subscription plugin for DSH

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness：MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API、NewMate 陪伴内核与 heartBeat 重启投递，五个独立开关，共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。
Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: ⚠️内测中勿下载⚠️爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed l
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.

A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话中搜索、安装和管理 SkillHub 技能
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付

Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
description.zh: 原生实现 Claude Code 式自动记忆:类型化记忆文件(user/feedback/project/reference)+ 自动注入系统提示词的 MEMORY.md 索引,无记忆时零提示词占用;memory_write/read/list/delete 遵循 Claude Code 写入规则(查重更新、相对日期转绝对、交叉链接);项目级与用户级双层作用域,跨进程文件锁与孤儿锁自愈,记忆为磁盘纯 Markdown,无外部服务、无 embedding。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。

Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance toolkit. Independently tune opacity + frosted-glass blur across 8 surfaces (main background, sidebar, cards & panels, inputs & controls, settings, conversation frame, trajectory view, produced/highlights — 9 with dsh-better-sidebar). Use any image or video as wallpaper with a drag-to-pan, scroll-to-zoom position editor and 5 layout modes (Fit/Fill/Stretch/Tile/Center); videos loop muted, survive refresh, and capture a live frame for preview, color extraction and framing. Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观一体化工具。对 8 个界面区域分别调节透明度与毛玻璃模糊（主背景、侧边栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页、产出物/高亮内容；安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后为 9 个）。用任意图片或视频做壁纸，配有拖动平移、滚轮缩放的位置编辑器与 5 种布局模式（适应/填充/拉伸/平铺/居中）；视频静音循环播放、刷新不丢失，并自动截取一帧用于预览、取色与构图。把多张图片加入轮换池（随机/顺序，每次刷新/每天/每周）自动更换。还包含 PS 风格色轮、一键从壁纸提取主题色、6 套预设 + 命名配置、昼夜自动切换与主题一键导出导入。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Provides a subscription status readout for ChatGPT within DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 ChatGPT 订阅状态显示。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: MC 资产面板 + 「MC 模组工作室」模式 + mc-mod / mc-art 两个 skill：3D+物品栏、像素/结构编辑器、出错的报告自动放进输入框、GameTest 判定闭环。原生 Windows 可用（不需要 WSL），不绑定任何具体 mod。

Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与 DSH。用户新建的所有终端支持与AI可视化协作。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、浏览 dshbase 插件库，获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，不用离开会话。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud / self-hosted / WeChat-bot tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas; the WeChat bot channel is bound by QR scan and pushes task-finished / error / stopped events to WeChat, where one number in reply approves or denies a pending decision and continues the current task — WeChat messages travel only between Tencent ilink and the local bridge, never through the relay.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端 / 自建 / 微信机器人三个 tab、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额；微信机器人通道扫码绑定后，把任务完成 / 出错 / 停下推送到微信，需要拍板时回一个数字即可放行或拒绝，回话可直接继续当前任务——微信消息只经腾讯 ilink 与本机 bridge，不经中继。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: a few configs that set how fast a task runs — bound where thinking settles, bound the process narration, bound the steps per task — faster delivery without touching the model or its thinking strength. Measured over 10 task families and 30 complete units: the default reaches 0.72x total time, 0.74x output tokens and 0.71x steps; moving the "write it once" reminder from step 4 to step 2 gives debugfix 0.535x, ledger 0.506x, migrate 0.751x, and 0.625x pooled over 13 pairs with 0.614x output tokens (migrate alone 0.509x with 0.528x output at step 3). Hidden tests passed in every pair. Short 1-5 step repairs and data reshaping do not pay for the reminder, so try it once per task shape.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的快速模式：用几项配置控制任务的运行速度——限制思考在哪一步收敛、限制中间汇报的输出、限制最多几步，在不改变模型与思考强度的前提下把任务做快。实测 10 类任务 30 个完整单元：默认配置总耗时 0.72×、输出 token 0.74×、步数 0.71×；把「省着写」提醒从第 4 步提前到第 2 步，debugfix 0.535×、ledger 0.506×、migrate 0.751×，13 对合并 0.625×、输出 token 0.614×（第 3 步时 migrate 单族 0.509×、输出 0.528×）。每一对里两臂隐藏断言逐格相同、全绿。1–5 步的小改修与数据整形收不回提醒成本，按任务形状先试一次再定。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面追踪 DeepSeek Token 用量、单次与会话费用及账户余额，并显示缓存感知的扣费动画。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

description.en: Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation, then save a complete static view while preserving existing cameras and animation. Repair repeating texture coordinates on planar custom mesh faces while preserving geometry. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Native geometry inspections, immutable revisions and an approval gate help preserve existing work. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and the legacy host, with 20 tools for modeling, review and delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存，再另存完整静态取景，保留原相机和动画。逐面修复自定义网格上的重复纹理坐标并保持几何不变。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材导出为可编辑副本。原生几何检查、不可变历史和审批闸门帮助保留已有作品。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 并保留旧宿主入口，提供 20 个建模、评审与交付工具。

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Keyless web search with one web_tools entry and eight actions for multi-query search, date windows, packages, papers, repositories, platforms, page reading, cited research, cache search and engine health; fuses eight engines and ships a stdio MCP server for other agents.
description.zh: 免密钥网页搜索：一个 web_tools 入口、八个 action，覆盖多查询、日期窗口、包、论文、仓库、平台、正文读取、引用研究、缓存检索与引擎健康；融合八个引擎，并提供给其他 Agent 使用的 stdio MCP server。
